match_rule.description: index = max(floor, 1 - min(cap, slope*dist_outside_temp_window) - min(cap, slope*dist_outside_humidity_window)). Recovered from condition_match_score in weather_readings_with_disease.csv (max error 0.0004, i.e. rounding).

levels.description: Match-index cut-offs used for alerts and UI labels. Design choice, not taken from the CSV (the CSV's risk_category is a percentile cut on disease_risk).

risk_category_cuts.description: Percentile cut-offs of the original disease_risk column (25/50/25 split).

Blister Blight.description: Fungal disease of young tea shoots; thrives in cool, very humid, cloudy conditions.

Grey Blight.description: Leaf-spot fungus of mature leaves; favoured by warm, humid weather.

Brown Blight.description: Fungal leaf disease; favoured by warm, wet weather.

Red Spider Mite.origin: literature_assumption - NOT in the original dataset, validate with an agronomist
Red Spider Mite.description: Mite pest that builds up in hot, dry spells.

Shot-hole Borer.origin: literature_assumption - NOT in the original dataset, validate with an agronomist
Shot-hole Borer.description: Stem-boring beetle; more active in warm, drier weather and on stressed bushes.

Algal Leaf Spot.origin: literature_assumption - NOT in the original dataset, validate with an agronomist
Algal Leaf Spot.description: Algal infection of leaves; favoured by warm, very humid, wet conditions.
